caption:
What Yaqub said when his heart was breaking

Prophet Yaqub had already lost Yusuf, and now another son was gone. Listen to how he answered his sons, with patience and hope in the same words.

Surah Yusuf 12:83

Send this to someone who is still waiting for something to come back.

#grief #beautifulpatience #prophetyaqub #surahyusuf #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
alt_text: He said, “No, but your souls have enticed you to commit something. But I will bear this with beautiful patience; perhaps Allah will bring them all back to me, for He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.” (Surah Yusuf 12:83)
theme: grief and hope / Yaqub's beautiful patience
